claim: E3M1 wraps its street round one 14,848-unit block and fronts its other buildings as masses at the street's edge; TEDE1M2's dense core has 1 loop in 58 street sectors (a web of lanes round a square) and DWE3M10 one. But DWE3M1 loops 8 small blocks, as many as DukCity's 7-11, so a Blood town may loop or not; E3M1's model needs no grid of blocks.
evidence: tools/mine_city_norms.py: E3M1 1 loop, DWE3M1 8, DukCity1-4 7-11 (knowledge/blood/references/city-norms.md:48-67); TEDE1M2 1, DWE3M10 1, E3M2 3, E3M1 2 in the v2 run (city-norms-v2.json summary.street_loops)
use: A Blood town need not be a grid of blocks you walk round: front the street with masses and let lanes end.
